normalization: Cast to string, convert missing to 'nan'
missing_value_rules: Missing values treated as distinct 'nan' categories
semantic_interpretation: Represents an aggregate payment-instrument slice (card BIN/type + billing region + email provider), NOT an individual customer.
longitudinal_validity: LIMITED. Valid for tracking aggregate instrument/regional traffic patterns over time, but invalid for modeling individual human state sequences due to massive device/user collisions.
collision_risks: EXTREME. High-frequency categories (e.g., generic anonymous.com domains, massive issuer BINs, large zip codes) collapse hundreds of distinct devices and users into a single entity.
extreme_entity_policy: Model extreme entities as a separate population or cap historical contribution.
decision_rationale: IEEE-CIS anonymization fields (Card BIN + Zip + Email Domain) do not contain a unique user identifier. Rare combinations mimic individuals, but common combinations collapse up to 600 distinct devices into a single proxy. This destroys the construct validity of an 'originating individual' sequence. Therefore, no defensible individual proxy can be found.
